verdict.rationale: Supermemory publishes a full API reference with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec (confirmed live at runtime) and official TypeScript/Python clients, plus numerous code snippets across docs (add, search, memory operations) that a developer can copy and run. However, there is no explicit evidence of an interactive in-browser 'try it now' console or executable code sandbox within the API reference itself — only static docs and SDK snippets. Missing for 10: confirmation of an actual interactive/try-it API playground, evidence of live request execution from the docs UI, and independent hands-on confirmation of that interactivity.
